description: Electricity Network Coverage is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides information about the coverage and availability of network supply of electricity in Qatar at the national level, expressed as a percentage, for the years 2020 to 2025. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are Access to Electricity. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
